title: Formal density definitions for Erdős 279 via Mathlib asymptotic analysis

problemStatement.formal: HasPrimeLikeDensity A := ∃ c > 0, ∀ᶠ N, c·N/log N ≤ |A ∩ [1,N]|; HasLogLogDivergence A := ∑_{n∈A,n≤N} 1/n − log(log N) → +∞
problemStatement.plain: Formalize the density conditions from Erdős Problem 279 OQ-04: replace placeholder True bodies with rigorous Mathlib-based asymptotic definitions, prove monotonicity and infinitude properties, and verify primes satisfy both conditions.
whyMatters: Provides rigorous formal definitions replacing placeholder True bodies in the parent proof
Demonstrates that c·N/log N → ∞ (needed for prime-like density → infinitude) is provable from Mathlib asymptotic primitives
Establishes infrastructure for analyzing prime-like density sets in Lean 4
